content.text: From Season 4 Filming Nears Completion, Hints At 2026 ReleaseFrom season 4 gets a promising update from star Ricky He. From's cast of characters features Ricky as Kenny Liu, one of the main characters trapped in the mysterious Township that is plagued by vicious nocturnal monsters and other sinister forces.Ahead of From season 3's game-changing ending released in November 2024, the MGM+ horror series was renewed for a fourth season. Season 4 began filming in June, and with a release window of 2026, more than a year will have passed between seasons.Now, on Instagram, Ricky He provides a promising update with a caption that begins "final lap season 4."
